name: Demo IFT-like suborbital flight (illustrative)
description: ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO ONLY. All trajectory points and events are an approximation of a generic IFT-like suborbital profile (Starbase to an Indian Ocean splashdown) and are NOT derived from official flight data or telemetry. The numbers (positions, altitudes, timings, implied speeds) are rough illustrative values shaped from general public knowledge of such flights. Quality: Simulated. The launchTimeUtc below is a placeholder and must be set manually (or overridden with --launch-time) to the intended launch time.
